title: Publish this review page as the front door for changes
proposal: Keep one page that lists every proposed change with its cost, risk and the decisions it depends on, plus a recommended path. Nothing is implemented until a path is chosen here.
problem: Improvement ideas were scattered across audit logs and COORDINATION.md, so a reviewer could not compare options before work started.
risk: The page can go stale if it is not regenerated by the build — it is, and a test asserts the page and its CSV agree.

title: Publish the open-question register with a closure test per item
proposal: Each question states what we know, what is missing, how it would be closed and which decision it blocks; unanswered ones are BLOCKED with a blank answer, never a guess.
problem: The biggest risk to this project is a confident number with no provenance.
risk: Requires discipline: a question is only ANSWERED when the evidence link is live.

title: Regenerate every downloadable CSV from the page that cites it
proposal: Add a build check that each mirrored CSV is produced by the current run; retire prop_inputs.csv or regenerate it from the prop report.
problem: prop_inputs.csv still says player game logs are unreachable while 21,033 player-games ship.
risk: A stale file is the cheapest way to mislead a reviewer.

title: Add a per-row evidence-tier badge (official / primary / community / estimate)
proposal: Show the tier in the first column of every table so a reader does not have to infer it from the source link.
problem: Mixed evidence classes in one table invite over-reading.
risk: Badge inflation: an 'official' badge must mean the number itself is official.

title: Publish a build-to-build change log
proposal: Diff headline numbers (bets, ROI, p-value, MAE) against the previous published build and show what moved and why.
problem: Numbers moved between sessions without a reader-visible explanation.
risk: Requires a stored previous snapshot; keep it as a small JSON, not a copy of the site.

title: Mark each board row as scheduled, live or settled
proposal: Join official results where available and label week-8/9 rows as settled; stop calling a snapshot-wide 'upcoming' board upcoming per row.
problem: Week 8 games are Final on NFL.com while the board still lists them as open lines.
risk: Joining results to a frozen board can look like hindsight; label, do not re-price.

title: License an authenticated, timestamped price archive
evidence_status: No free source verified; commercial licence required
proposal: Buy or license quotes carrying book, market, price and timestamp (opening and closing), then rebuild the backtest on executable prices.
problem: Without it G1 fails for all 18 strategies and no ROI claim is possible.
risk: Cost, licence terms and historical depth are unknown; a cheap feed with no timestamps does not close the question.

title: Refresh the pinned snapshot and re-run the full audit
evidence_status: Procedure documented from the last refresh
proposal: Move the pin to current master, rebuild every artefact, re-run the clean-room audit and publish a reconciliation table of what moved.
problem: The board is ten days stale and cannot be joined to the live injury report.
risk: Moves every published number and needs an audit pass; do it after S07 so prices and results refresh together.

title: Extend player-level data to 2023–2026 and re-estimate props
proposal: Add pinned season blobs, re-run the prop model and test whether dependence and calibration survive the era gap.
problem: Prop evidence stops at 2022, so nothing can support a 2026 ticket.
risk: More data does not fix missing prices; still no prop ROI without S10.

title: Capture real same-game parlay quotes
evidence_status: Manual capture; requires an operator account
proposal: Record SGP prices (legs, correlation adjustment, timestamp, book) for a fixed slate and compare them with the calculated joint probabilities.
problem: Three combos have verified structure but G6 fails because no ticket price exists.
risk: Operator terms vary by state and change; capture must be timestamped.

title: Get a written legal opinion before any prize is offered
recommendation: Blocked until Path D is considered
evidence_status: Not researched; no source can substitute for advice
proposal: Have counsel confirm whether a rewarded strategy competition is lawful in the owner's jurisdiction, what disclaimers are needed and whether entry fees change the analysis.
problem: Q13 is unresearched; the site currently advertises no prize, and that is deliberate.
risk: Cost and time; any prize wording before advice is a risk.

title: Pre-register the next library and freeze it
evidence_status: Protocol text exists on the validation page
proposal: Write down the candidates, thresholds and evaluation window before looking at results; log every trial so the deflated Sharpe denominator is known.
problem: DSR is provisional because only a lower bound of 60 trials is documented.
risk: A pre-registration that is edited after results is worse than none; hash the file.

title: Replace the trial-count lower bound with an auditable count
proposal: Emit one record per fitted candidate from the pipeline, so the multiplicity correction uses a measured denominator.
problem: Multiplicity correction is only as honest as the trial count.
risk: Counting code variants can overstate trials; define the unit precisely.

title: Add a placebo/permutation suite for parlays and props
proposal: Shuffle outcomes within week, re-run the selection, and require the real result to beat the placebo distribution.
problem: Parlay ROI can look real when leg dependence and selection interact.
risk: Placebo design can be gamed; fix the seed and the shuffle unit in advance.

title: Source archived forecasts with issue times for weather angles
proposal: Replace recorded game-time weather with a pre-kickoff forecast archive so the wind and cold candidates can be tested without hindsight.
problem: Weather is excluded from the default model for exactly this reason.
risk: Forecast archives are often paywalled and may not be point-in-time complete.

title: Automate a dated weekly injury capture
evidence_status: Pilot capture delivered for 2026 week 10 and 2019 week 5
proposal: Capture the official report each week with a UTC timestamp and the kickoff time, store it as a hash-pinned JSON, and publish the count of captured games.
problem: Q28 and Q32: the feed exists but the timing rule and history are unverified.
risk: nfl.com is unreachable from the build; the capture needs a networked runner or an agent step, so it is not yet hands-off.

title: Obtain a depth chart or starter/inactive source and classify depth
evidence_status: Two club charts verified 2026-11-12; 30 clubs and timing open
proposal: Use a licensed depth chart or official gamebook inactives to label each player 1st/2nd/3rd string before kickoff, with the rule published.
problem: Q30: club charts exist (2 verified) but the league site has none, so coverage and timing are the gaps.
risk: Third-party depth charts are unofficial and sometimes wrong; the classification rule must be auditable and timestamped.

title: Build a replacement-level deficit index, but keep it out of the leaderboard
proposal: Score each unit (QB, OL, CB, LB) by who is missing relative to depth, using only pre-kickoff information, and publish it as a labelled research feature.
problem: The availability requirement is specified and its inputs partly exist, but nothing is computed.
risk: A deficit index invites storytelling; it must be gated like any other signal.

title: Pilot a participation-based depth proxy on 2019–2022
proposal: Rank players within position by prior-week snap/play share and measure how often the top-ranked player actually starts; compare with a licensed depth chart if one is obtained.
problem: Q33: a data-driven proxy may be cheaper than a licensed depth chart.
risk: Play share is not snap count; the proxy may misclassify rotation players.

title: Raise parlay volume until ROI turns positive
proposal: Add more 2- and 3-leg combos built from the best-performing legs.
problem: Choosing legs by observed ROI is selection on noise.
risk: This is the failure mode the eight gates exist to prevent.

title: Relax the gates so a strategy can be presented as a winner
evidence_status: Rejected: G1 cannot be met by threshold changes
proposal: Lower the ROI, power or multiplicity thresholds until one candidate passes.
problem: A leaderboard with no winner is uncomfortable but correct.
risk: Publishing a loosened gate set would make every other number meaningless.

title: Add a dated decision log (DECISIONS.md)
evidence_status: Delivered: DECISIONS.md created in this build
proposal: One row per decision: date, owner, chosen path, evidence snapshot, reversal condition, and the tests that must pass.
problem: Q36: decisions live in prose inside an append-only coordination log.
risk: A log that is not linked from the review page will be ignored.
